newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 23.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Chiang Hsiao-yung, grandson of Chinese Nationalist leader Chiang Kai-shek, dies of oesophageal cancer.
Asian-American scientist David Ho is named Time Magazine's Man of Year.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - National Development Conference begins Monday.
Bible has translated versions in eight local Taiwan dialects.
LIBERTY TIMES - Hong Kong's "bad precendent" only will create further schism between Taipei, Beijing.
Taiwan-born David Ho revolutionises treatement for AIDS.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Apple Computer brings back fired co-founder Steven Jobs.
Hong Kong is world's most popular region for banks to set up overseas branches.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - National Development Conference not expected to change investment policies toward China.
Central bank likely to maintain "stable-to-loose" monetary policy.
